items.title: First H5 bird flu case confirmed on SA metro beach

children.content: The CSIRO says two native birds found dead on separate beaches in South Australia have tested positive for the H5 strain of bird flu. It's the first time a case has been confirmed on a SA metropolitan beach.

items.title: Sobers could only do everything — including for SA's Sheffield Shield side

children.content: In 1961, Sir Garfield Sobers was almost indisputably the world’s greatest cricketer. In a masterstroke, South Australian administrators were able to secure his services and, by extension, a path to Sheffield Shield triumph.
